name: Academia Joven de España
description: Academia Joven de España aims to promote and support outstanding early-career researchers in Spain, while inspiring scientific vocations among younger generations across all fields of knowledge.

name: AuditAI (UAH)
description: The AuditAI research group at the University of Alcalá specializes in the development and analysis of complex software systems, high-quality software engineering practices, audits of AI developments, and AI applications in programming environments.

name: Centro de Investigación en Ciencias del Deporte (URJC)
description: The CIDE Research Center at Rey Juan Carlos University is a multidisciplinary center dedicated to advancing high-quality research and training in Sport Sciences, contributing actively to fields such as physical activity, health, and athletic performance.

name: Centro de Investigación en Ciencias de Información Geoespacial
description: CentroGeo is a research center in Mexico dedicated to advancing geospatial information science, generating and applying cutting-edge knowledge and technologies to address territorial and environmental challenges.

name: DeNexus
description: DeNexus provides a full-stack cyber risk quantification and management platform specifically designed for industrial sectors such as energy, manufacturing, data centers, transportation, and critical infrastructures.

name: Department of Industrial Engineering (UChile)
description: The Department of Industrial Engineering at the University of Chile is a leading academic center in Latin America renowned for research and education in operations research, data science, and management engineering.

name: Ericsson
description: Ericsson is a global leader in telecommunications and networking technology, providing infrastructure, services, and software solutions for mobile and fixed broadband networks and 5G innovation.

name: Grupo de Ingeniería de Medios (UEx)
description: The Media Engineering Group (GIM) at the University of Extremadura focuses on developing efficient and effective methods for extracting semantic content and knowledge representation from digital information.

name: Grupo de investigación en Aplicaciones Sociales e Interdisciplinares basadas en Agentes (UCM)
description: GRASIA is a research group focused on designing and engineering sociotechnical systems to empower communities, combining software engineering, artificial intelligence, data mining, and multi-agent simulation.

name: Grupo de Optimización (US)
description: The Optimization Research Group at the University of Seville works in data science, operations research, mathematical modeling applied to industry, and mathematical optimization with applications to machine learning.

name: Indra
description: Indra is a global technology and consulting leader known for its commitment to innovation and advanced solutions across aerospace, defense, mobility, and digital services worldwide.

name: Instituto de Investigación Biomédica de Salamanca
description: The Institute for Biomedical Research of Salamanca (IBSAL) integrates clinical, translational, epidemiological, and health services research from the University Hospital and University of Salamanca.

name: Interdisciplinary Mathematics Institute (UCM)
description: IMI at Complutense University of Madrid promotes research, collaboration, and innovation across mathematical disciplines, connecting mathematicians with scientists to solve complex real-world problems.

name: MedLab Media Group (now dezzai)
description: Dezzai (formerly MedLab Media Group) is a technology company applying artificial intelligence, natural language processing, and data analytics to drive digital transformation in the healthcare ecosystem.

name: School of Science & Technology (IE)
description: The School of Science & Technology at IE University offers modern STEM education and research focused on artificial intelligence, applied data analytics, and real-world technology challenges.

name: SensoWave
description: SensoWave creates innovative products and services in wireless IoT technologies, sensor telemetry, and big data across livestock, environmental monitoring, and industrial applications.

name: Sistemas Complejos y Física Fundamental (URJC)
description: The SCFF Research Group at Rey Juan Carlos University focuses on the study, modeling, and prediction of complex systems, network science, fluid dynamics, and Bayesian inference.

name: Tecnologías para el Análisis y Diagnóstico Territorial (URJC)
description: TADAT Research Group at Rey Juan Carlos University focuses on spatial AI, territorial analysis, environmental diagnosis, and ecosystem monitoring in protected areas and biosphere reserves.
